sections.h: Algorithm: Clubbing of finger (เล่มเหลือง 2.5)

sub.html:
• Floating nail sign
  • Shammerot’s sign
  • Diameter of nail Bed > DIP
  • Profile sign (earliest sign)
  • Drumstick-like of terminal phalanx

sub.h: Secondary — สาเหตุแยกตามระบบ
sub.html:
ระบบสาเหตุ
CardioCyanotic heart disease · Infective endocarditis
PulmonaryNeoplasm: Bronchial carcinoma, Lung metastasis, Mesothelioma
Chronic lung disease: Bronchiectasis, Emphysema, IPF
Infection: Lung abscess, Empyema
GICirrhosis · IBD: Crohn’s disease, Ulcerative colitis · Celiac disease · Esophagus: CA, achalasia
MiscellaneousEndocrine: Thyrotoxicosis, POEMS
Hematologic: PV with Hypoxia, Methemoglobinemia, Lymphoma
Autoimmune: PAN, SLE

sections.h: Causes of Clubbing — mnemonic “CLUBBING” (รูปแทรกในเล่มเหลือง)
sections.html:
• C → Cyanotic Heart dis. · Cystic Fibrosis
  • L → Lung Cancer · Lung abscess
  • U → Ulcerative Colitis
  • B → Bronchiectasis
  • B → Benign mesothelioma
  • I → Infective Endocarditis · Idiopathic Pulmonary fibrosis
  • N → Neurogenic tumors
  • G → Gastrointestinal dis.
